pairs.he: אֲבָל אָנוּ מְבַקְּשִׁים, שֶׁיִּתֵּן וְיִמְסֹר בְּיָדֵינוּ אֶת הָרַחֲמָנוּת, כִּי אֵין אָנוּ מְבִינִים הָרַחֲמָנוּת שֶׁלּוֹ וְגַם אֵין אָנוּ יְכוֹלִין לְקַבֵּל אוֹתוֹ הָרַחֲמָנוּת שֶׁלּוֹ הַנַּ״ל, רַק שֶׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ יִתֵּן בְּיָדֵינוּ אֶת הָרַחֲמָנוּת, שֶׁאֲנַחְנוּ בְּעַצְמֵנוּ נְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ, וְאֶצְלֵנוּ הָרַחֲמָנוּת בִּפְשִׁיטוּת, לְהִתְרַפֵּא מִן הַחֹלִי וְכַיּוֹצֵא בָּזֶה. וְזֶהוּ ׳יִשְׂרָאֵל׳ רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת אֵל שַׁדַּי יִתֵּן לָכֶם רַחֲמִים קמ.
pairs.en: But we ask that He give and entrust the compassion into our hands, for we do not understand His compassion, and we also cannot receive that aforementioned compassion of His. Rather, may the blessed God grant the compassion into our hands, so that we ourselves will have compassion on ourselves. For us, compassion is simply to recover from the illness and the like. This is “Yisrael,” the initial letters of אֵל שַׁדַּי יִתֵּן לָכֶם רַחֲמִים—“God Almighty will grant you mercy.” [Printed note marker 140.]

pairs.he: וזה בחינת מה שכתב רבנו ז״ל בַּמַּאֲמָר הַנַּ״ל שֶׁאָנוּ צְרִיכִין שֶׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ יִתֵּן בְּיָדֵינוּ אֶת הָרַחֲמָנוּת שֶׁאֲנַחְנוּ בְּעַצְמֵנוּ נְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ, בְּחִינַת אֵל שַׁדַּי יִתֵּן לָכֶם רַחֲמִים וְכוּ׳ כִּי אֵצֶל הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ יָכוֹל לִהְיוֹת שֶׁחַס וְשָׁלוֹם הַיִּסּוּרִין יִהְיֶה רַחֲמָנוּת וְכוּ׳ כַּנַּ״ל. וְלִכְאוֹרָה קָשֶׁה לְהָבִין דִּבְרֵי רַבֵּנוּ ז״ל, כִּי מֵאַחַר שֶׁבֶּאֱמֶת כַּוָּנַת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ לְטוֹבָה וְהַיִּסּוּרִין שֶׁעוֹשֶׂה לְאָדָם חַס וְשָׁלוֹם הִיא בֶּאֱמֶת רַחֲמָנוּתוֹ, כִּי כַּוָּנָתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ לְטוֹבַת הָאָדָם, אִם כֵּן מַה זֶּה שֶׁכָּתַב שֶׁאָנוּ צְרִיכִין שֶׁיִּתֵּן בְּיָדֵינוּ אֶת הָרַחֲמָנוּת וְכוּ׳ שֶׁאֲנַחְנוּ בְּעַצְמֵנוּ נְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ כַּנַּ״ל, וְאֵיךְ נוּכַל לְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ בְּעַצְמֵנוּ אִם בֶּאֱמֶת אֵין זֶה טוֹבָה.
pairs.en: And this is the aspect of what our master, of blessed memory, wrote in the aforementioned discourse: that we need the blessed God to entrust the compassion into our hands, so that we ourselves will have compassion on ourselves, the aspect of “God Almighty will grant you mercy,” etc. For with the blessed God, it may be that, Heaven forbid, the sufferings will be compassion, etc., as explained above. At first sight, our master’s words, of blessed memory, are difficult to understand. For since the blessed God’s intention is truly for good, and the sufferings He inflicts upon a person, Heaven forbid, are truly His compassion—since His intention, blessed be He, is for the person’s good—then what is this that he wrote: that we need Him to entrust the compassion into our hands, etc., so that we ourselves will have compassion on ourselves, as explained above? How can we have compassion on ourselves if this is truly not good?

For since the blessed God’s intention is truly for good, and the sufferings He inflicts upon a person, Heaven forbid, are truly His compassion—since His intention, blessed be He, is for the person’s good—then what is this that he wrote: that we need Him to entrust the compassion into our hands, etc., so that we ourselves will have compassion on ourselves, as explained above? How can we have compassion on ourselves if this is truly not good?

pairs.he: לְמָשָׁל הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ יוֹדֵעַ שֶׁזֶּה הָאָדָם אֵין צָרִיךְ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לוֹ מָמוֹן וְהוּא טוֹבָה לְפָנָיו, כִּי אִם יִהְיֶה לוֹ מָמוֹן יִהְיֶה לוֹ הֶזֵּק בְּעִנְיָן אַחֵר. וּבִשְׁבִיל זֶה אֵינוֹ נוֹתֵן לוֹ מָמוֹן, וְכִי זוֹ הִיא טוֹבָה שֶׁיִּמְסֹר הָרַחֲמָנוּת בְּיַד הָאָדָם כַּנַּ״ל וְהָאָדָם יִרְצֶה שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לוֹ מָמוֹן וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה יִגְרֹם לְעַצְמוֹ הֶזֵּק גָּדוֹל מִזֶּה בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר וְיִהְיֶה הַהֶפְסֵד מְרֻבֶּה מִשְּׂכָרוֹ. וְכַיּוֹצֵא בָּזֶה בִּשְׁאָר הַדְּבָרִים. וְכִי תִּינוֹק שֶׁרוֹצֶה דָּבָר שֶׁאֵינוֹ טוֹב לְפָנָיו בֶּאֱמֶת, וְכִי זֶה הוּא רַחֲמָנוּת שֶׁאָבִיו יְמַלֵּא תַּאֲוָתוֹ מֵאַחַר שֶׁיּוֹדֵעַ בֶּאֱמֶת שֶׁיַּזִּיק לוֹ זֶה הַדָּבָר.
pairs.en: For example, the blessed God knows that this person does not need to have money, and that this is good for him; for if he has money, he will suffer harm in another matter. For this reason He does not give him money. Is it a good, then, that He should entrust compassion into the person’s hands, as explained above, and the person should want to have money and thereby cause himself great harm from it elsewhere, so that the loss will be greater than his gain? Likewise with other things. Is it compassion, when a child wants something that is truly not good for him, that his father should satisfy his desire, when he truly knows that this thing will harm him?

Likewise with other things. Is it compassion, when a child wants something that is truly not good for him, that his father should satisfy his desire, when he truly knows that this thing will harm him?

pairs.he: אַךְ בֶּאֱמֶת כָּל זֶה הוּא בְּחִינַת רַחֲמִים סְתָם, וּבִבְחִינַת רַחֲמִים זֶה עַל פִּי בְּחִינַת דִּין וּמִשְׁפָּט, וְעַל כֵּן יָכוֹל לִהְיוֹת שֶׁיִּסּוּרִים חַס וְשָׁלוֹם יִהְיֶה רַחֲמָנוּת, כִּי הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ יוֹדֵעַ שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה יִהְיֶה לוֹ טוֹבָה בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר. וְאִם לֹא הָיָה לוֹ אֵלּוּ הַיִּסּוּרִים חַס וְשָׁלוֹם לֹא הָיָה אֶפְשָׁר שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לוֹ טוֹבָה בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר, כִּי אֵין הָרַחֲמִים מְחַיֵּב לְהֵטִיב לוֹ הַכֹּל בְּכָל הָעִנְיָנִים, כִּי הוּא בְּחִינַת רַחֲמִים סְתָם שֶׁיֵּשׁ שָׁם בְּחִינַת צִמְצוּם עֲדַיִן.
pairs.en: But in truth, all this is the aspect of ordinary mercies; in this aspect, mercies are according to the aspect of judgment and justice. Therefore it is possible that sufferings, Heaven forbid, will be compassion, for the blessed God knows that through this he will have good elsewhere. If he did not have these sufferings, Heaven forbid, it would be impossible for him to have good elsewhere. For compassion does not oblige doing all good for him in all matters; it is the aspect of ordinary mercies, where an aspect of contraction still remains.

pairs.he: אֲבָל אָנוּ מְבַקְּשִׁין שֶׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ יְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ בִּבְחִינַת רַחֲמִים גְּדוֹלִים רַחֲמִים רַבִּים וְשָׁם כֻּלּוֹ רַחֲמִים וָחֶסֶד. וְאָז יָכוֹל הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ לִמְסֹר בְּיָדֵינוּ הָרַחֲמָנוּת כַּנַּ״ל שֶׁאֲנַחְנוּ בְּעַצְמֵנוּ נְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ וְלֹא יַזִּיק לָנוּ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם בְּשׁוּם אֹפֶן, כִּי גַם שָׁם בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר יֵיטִיב עִמָּנוּ גַם כֵּן בְּרַחֲמָיו הַמְרֻבִּים, כִּי בְּוַדַּאי מִמֶּנּוּ יִתְבָּרַךְ לֹא יִפָּלֵא כָּל דָּבָר וּבְוַדַּאי הוּא יִתְבָּרַךְ יָכוֹל לְהֵטִיב לָאָדָם בְּכָל הָעִנְיָנִים וּבְכָל הָאוֹפַנִּים שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם, רַק כְּשֶׁהָרַחֲמִים הֵם בְּצִמְצוּם עֲדַיִן בְּחִינַת רַחֲמִים סְתָם כַּנַּ״ל בְּהֶכְרַח שֶׁלִּפְעָמִים יִהְיוּ הַיִּסּוּרִים חַס וְשָׁלוֹם לְטוֹבָה מִצַּד הָרַחֲמִים, כִּי אִם לָאו יַפְסִיד חַס וְשָׁלוֹם יוֹתֵר מִזֶּה בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר וְכַנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: But we ask that the blessed God have compassion on us in the aspect of great mercies, abundant mercies, where all is mercy and kindness. Then the blessed God can entrust the compassion into our hands, as explained above, so that we ourselves will have compassion on ourselves, and it will not harm us, Heaven forbid, in any manner. For elsewhere too, He will likewise do good with us in His abundant mercies. Certainly nothing is beyond Him, blessed be He, and certainly He, blessed be He, can do good for a person in every matter and in all ways in the world. Only when the mercies are still in contraction, the aspect of ordinary mercies, as explained above, is it necessary that sometimes sufferings, Heaven forbid, be for good on account of mercy. For otherwise he will lose more than this elsewhere, Heaven forbid, as explained above.

qualifiedAfter.en: But we ask that the blessed God have compassion on us in the aspect of great mercies, abundant mercies, where all is mercy and kindness. Then the blessed God can entrust the compassion into our hands, as explained above, so that we ourselves will have compassion on ourselves, and it will not harm us, Heaven forbid, in any manner. For elsewhere too, He will likewise do good with us in His abundant mercies. Certainly nothing is beyond Him, blessed be He, and certainly He, blessed be He, can do good for a person in every matter and in all ways in the world. Only when the mercies are still in contraction, the aspect of ordinary mercies, as explained above, is it necessary that sometimes sufferings, Heaven forbid, be for good on account of mercy. For otherwise he will lose more than this elsewhere, Heaven forbid, as explained above.

pairs.he: אֲבָל כְּשֶׁזּוֹכִין לִבְחִינַת רַחֲמִים רַבִּים שָׁם אֵין שׁוּם צִמְצוּם וְדִין וְיָכוֹל לְהַסְפִּיק הָרַחֲמָנוּת לְכָל הָעִנְיָנִים וְהָאוֹפַנִּים וְעַל כֵּן אָז בְּוַדַּאי יָכוֹל לִמְסֹר בְּיָדֵינוּ הָרַחֲמָנוּת כַּנַּ״ל שֶׁאֲנַחְנוּ בְּעַצְמֵנוּ נְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ בִּרְצוֹנֵנוּ כִּי לֹא יַזִּיק לָנוּ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר, כִּי גַם שָׁם יְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ בְּרַחֲמָיו הַמְרֻבִּים, מֵאַחַר שֶׁשָּׁם כֻּלּוֹ רַחֲמִים כַּנַּ״ל. וּבִשְׁבִיל זֶה הֵם נִקְרָאִים רַחֲמִים רַבִּים, כִּי הֵם רַחֲמִים רַבִּים שֶׁמְּרַחֵם עַל הָאָדָם בְּהַרְבֵּה מִינֵי רַחֲמָנוּת בְּכָל הַמְּקוֹמוֹת וּבְכָל הָעִנְיָנִים שֶׁהוּא צָרִיךְ רַחֲמָנוּת.
pairs.en: But when one merits the aspect of abundant mercies, there is no contraction or judgment at all there, and the compassion can suffice for all matters and ways. Therefore He can certainly then entrust the compassion into our hands, as explained above, so that we ourselves will have compassion on ourselves according to our will. For it will not harm us elsewhere, Heaven forbid, because there too He will have compassion on us in His abundant mercies, since there all is mercy, as explained above. For this reason they are called abundant mercies, for they are abundant mercies whereby He has compassion on a person with many kinds of compassion, in all places and in all matters in which he needs compassion.

qualifiedAfter.en: But when one merits the aspect of abundant mercies, there is no contraction or judgment at all there, and the compassion can suffice for all matters and ways. Therefore He can certainly then entrust the compassion into our hands, as explained above, so that we ourselves will have compassion on ourselves according to our will. For it will not harm us elsewhere, Heaven forbid, because there too He will have compassion on us in His abundant mercies, since there all is mercy, as explained above. For this reason they are called abundant mercies, for they are abundant mercies whereby He has compassion on a person with many kinds of compassion, in all places and in all matters in which he needs compassion.

pairs.he: מוהרנ״ת ז״ל במכתבו (עלים לתרופה) כתב (מכתב רט״ז): כבר דברתי עמך וכתבתי לך הרבה בזה כמה וכמה צריך זה האדם העלוב לסבול בזה העולם כל ימי חייו, כמובא בספרים בזה הלשון אין רגע בלא פגע אין יום וכו׳, אין חודש אין שבוע אין שנה וכו׳. כמבואר בספר של״ה. ואנו מאמינים שהכל לטובה, כי מדה טובה מרובה. וצריכין ליזהר מאד לקיים מאמר רבותינו זכרונם לברכה שאמרו יהא אדם רגיל לומר כל מה דעבד רחמנא לטב עבד. ובפרט מה שכתוב בספרי הקדושים שצריכין לדעת שכל מאורעותיו הם לטובתו. וזה מעין עולם הבא. ודיקא על ידי זה יכולין להתחזק להתפלל על כל דבר. כי צריכין לומר לפניו יתברך, רבונו של עולם בודאי כונתך לטובה ולרחמים. אבל אין בנו כח לקבל רחמים כאלו. ואנו צריכין שתמסור בידינו הרחמנות, כמו שכתוב על פסוק ואל שדי יתן לכם רחמים. ע״כ.
pairs.en: Rabbi Noson, of blessed memory, in his letter (Alim LiTiroofuh), wrote (letter 216): I have already spoken with you and written to you much about this: how very much this wretched person must bear in this world all the days of his life, as is brought in the books in these words: “There is no moment without a mishap; there is no day,” etc., “there is no month, there is no week, there is no year,” etc., as explained in the book ShLah. And we believe that everything is for good, for the measure of good is abundant. One must be very careful to fulfill the saying of our Rabbis of blessed memory, who said that a person should be accustomed to saying, “Everything that the Merciful One does, He does for good.” Especially what is written in the holy books: that one must know that all that befalls him is for his good. This is a foretaste of the World to Come. Precisely through this, one can strengthen oneself to pray concerning every matter. For one must say before Him, blessed be He: “Master of the world, certainly Your intention is for good and for mercy. But we do not have the strength to receive mercies such as these. We need You to entrust the compassion into our hands,” as is written on the verse “And God Almighty will grant you mercy.” End of quotation.
